title: Rathturtin, Clonroche, Co. Wexford, Y21YR66
description:
	Spacious Detached Family Home with Workshop and Paddock standing on 0.67 hectares/1.66 acres.
	Convenient location approximately 1.7 kilometres off the N30, with easy access to the N11, M11 and N25. The thriving village of Clonroche is less than a 10-minute drive away, the towns of Enniscorthy and New Ross are less than 20 minutes’ drive and Wexford Town 30 minutes’ drive.
	Early viewing comes highly recommended contact Kehoe & Associates on 053-9144393 for further information or to arrange your viewing.

Set in a peaceful rural setting, this impressive detached four-bedroom family home offers generously proportioned, light-filled accommodation together with excellent outdoor space, a substantial detached workshop and an adjoining paddock.

The property enjoys a convenient location approximately 1.7 kilometres off the N30, with easy access to the N11, M11 and N25. The thriving village of Clonroche is less than a 10-minute drive away and provides a wide range of everyday amenities, including shops, pharmacy, medical centre, primary school, filling station, pubs and church.

The surrounding countryside provides an excellent setting for walking, cycling and a variety of outdoor pursuits, while the area benefits from a strong community spirit with a range of local sporting and community organisations. Nearby attractions include the popular John F Kennedy Park and Secret Valley Wildlife Park.

Internally, the house is presented in good condition throughout and offers bright, well-proportioned accommodation. The ground floor comprises a welcoming entrance hallway, comfortable sitting room, kitchen, utility room, two double bedrooms — one of which benefits from an en-suite — and a family bathroom. The first floor provides two further generously sized double bedrooms.

Outside, a gravelled driveway and forecourt provide ample parking to the front, while a large wraparound concrete patio extends to the side and rear of the property, creating an excellent space for outdoor entertaining and relaxation. The gardens are predominantly laid in lawn and complemented by a mature selection of flowering shrubs and ornamental trees.

A particularly attractive feature of the property is the adjoining paddock, which benefits from its own separate entrance. The overall site, incorporating the house, workshop and paddock, extends to approximately 0.67 hectares (1.66 acres).

The detached workshop extends to approximately 90.50 sq. m. and has its own independent entrance, offering excellent versatility for a variety of trades, business uses, workshop requirements or storage. The building is fully finished internally and benefits from extensive power points and lighting, an inspection pit, full-height double-door access with an additional pedestrian door, and a substantial concrete parking area to the front.

Offering a combination of spacious family accommodation, generous grounds, a useful paddock and an exceptionally versatile workshop, this property provides an excellent opportunity for those seeking a rural lifestyle while remaining within easy reach of local amenities and the region's main road network.
